excerpt.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
excerpt.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

scope.zh: 异常、解冻项目、留在冷冻中后殖民环形世界的后续全部核对。
scope.en: Anomaly, thaw project and the ring-world colonisation follow-up fully checked.

distar.72.en: Deciding the clones' fate after colonisation

texts.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
texts.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

sections.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
sections.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]环形世界损坏的储存区深处，这些阴暗的舱体里面存放着数以千计处于冷冻状态的外星生物。有些仍然存活，但大部分似乎都遭遇了冷冻设备故障，已经化为一滩摊腐朽程度不同的污泥。

令人吃惊的是，所有的外星生物完全一样：分析显示他们都是基因克隆的产物。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]称我们可以将还活着的克隆体解冻。不过他们所处的环形世界目前已无法支持生命，我们必须得给他们提供一个住处。
texts.en:
The murky vats located deep in the ruined storage sections of [From.GetName] ring world contain thousands of alien creatures in cryostasis. Some are still living, while many thousands more appear to have suffered cryochamber malfunctions, leaving them as organic sludge in varying stages of decomposition.

Remarkably, all of the aliens are completely identical: analysis of their remains reveals them to be genetic clones. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests we could attempt to thaw out the living clones - though as their ring world is currently without life-support, we would have to give them some place to live.

label.zh: 这真让人兴奋，赶紧将他们解冻。
label.en: Thaw them out. This is exciting.

label.zh: 我们介入并不明智，还是保持距离进行研究吧。
label.en: It would be unwise to interfere. Study them from afar instead.

label.zh: 修复并殖民环形世界区段后
label.en: After repairing and colonising a ring-world segment

tooltips.zh: 将[From.GetName]环形世界上的有机渣滓清理干净。
tooltips.en: Exterminate the foul organics on the [From.GetName] ring world.

label.zh: 肮脏的异种生物，他们将被净化。
label.en: Foul xenos. They will be cleansed.

tooltips.zh: 将[From.GetName]上邪恶的异种渣滓净化。
tooltips.en: Cleanse the [From.GetName] ring world of its xeno scum.

label.zh: 真是可惜，我们这里没有他们的生存空间。
label.en: A pity we have no room for them.

label.zh: 修复并殖民环形世界区段后
label.en: After repairing and colonising a ring-world segment

texts.zh: 环绕[From.GetName]的环形世界上的冷冻舱内，有着数百个仍然存活的冷冻克隆人。与其让他们像同类一样慢慢死亡，我们的生物学家提议解冻他们。
texts.en: There are hundreds of still-living clones sealed in cryostasis chambers on the ruined Ring World surrounding [From.GetName]. Rather than let them slowly die off like many of their comrades, our biologists propose thawing them out.

texts.zh:
科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]高兴地汇报称除了少数无法挽救的个体，对冷冻克隆人的复活取得圆满成功，这些克隆人性情温顺，看上去对自己被创造后的世界毫无了解。[Root.GetLeaderName]猜测他们被建造[From.GetStarName]环形世界的物种当做劳工使用。

虽然这些克隆体愿意服从命令，[Root.GetLeaderName]指出对克隆体的神经共振扫描数据表明他们不擅长应付复杂的工作。
texts.en:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is pleased to report that barring a small number of unsalvageable cases, the revival of the derelict ring world clones from cryostasis has been a success. The clones are quite docile individuals, who appear to know nothing of the circumstances behind their creation. [Root.GetLeaderName] speculates that they were used as laborers by whatever ancient civilization constructed the [From.GetStarName] ring world.

The clones appear to be willing to follow orders, though [Root.GetLeaderName] cautions that preliminary neuro-resonance scanning suggests they are not the best equipped to deal with complex tasks.

label.zh: 让克隆体为我们进行工作。
我们星球上没有空间供他们居住，准备一艘船吧。
label.en: We have no room for them planetside. Prepare a ship.

label.zh: 我们应该热烈欢迎他们！
label.en: We welcome them with open arms!

label.zh: 他们将作为有益健康的食材为[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]作出贡献。
label.en: They will make healthy fodder for our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

tooltips.zh: 将克隆体加工为营养物质。

texts.zh: 现在我们重建并殖民了[Root.GetStarName]环形世界上的一个可居住区段，是时候决定如何处理这些处于冷冻状态的克隆体了。
texts.en: Now that we have colonized a reconstructed segment of the [Root.GetStarName] Ring World, we must decide what is to be done with the alien clones left behind in cryostasis on the megastructure's habitat sections.

label.zh: 就让他们继续处于休眠状态吧，正好作为纪念。
label.en: Leave them in stasis, as a monument.

label.zh: 将他们解冻，加入到我们的劳动力人口中。
label.en: Thaw them out. They can join our workforce.

label.zh: 将他们解冻，我们会照顾好他们的。
label.en: Thaw them out. We will care for them.

label.zh: 他们将作为有益健康的食材为[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]作出贡献。
label.en: They will make healthy fodder for our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

summary.text:
# 可疑的舱体 / Murky Vats

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/utopia_initializers.txt:818-849 (ring_world_init_01); common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:205-219; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:2803 (distar.70); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:2928 (distar.71); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3273 (distar.72); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:146 (CRYO_CLONES_PROJECT); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1304

## 如何开始 How it starts

“毁坏的环形世界”星系初始化（utopia_initializers.txt，至多一个）在拥有《遥远繁星》时有50%机会给恒星添加此异常（6级，全局一次）。

The Ruined Ring World system initializer (utopia_initializers.txt, at most one) has a 50% chance to add this level-6, once-per-game anomaly to the star when Distant Stars is owned.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.70“冷仓中的克隆体”：环形世界的储存区里有成千上万个完全相同的外星克隆体，部分仍存活；恒星获得物理学矿藏。
2. 解冻（a）→ CRYO_CLONES_PROJECT（30天，科研船+科学家）→ distar.71：复苏的克隆体温顺但不擅复杂工作，按文明类型加入人口、作为奴隶、被同化、被吃掉，或在没有居住空间时乘殖民船离开。
3. 远观研究（b）或“没有空间”（no_room）：星系恒星获得 clones_in_cryo。日后修复并殖民环形世界区段时，on_colonized 触发 distar.72，再决定这些克隆体的去留。
4. 终结者或狂热净化者可直接消灭他们（获得影响力和凝聚力）。

1. distar.70 "Clones in Cryostasis": thousands of identical alien clones lie in the ring world's storage vats, some still alive; the star gains a physics deposit.
2. Thaw them (a) → CRYO_CLONES_PROJECT (30 days, science ship + scientist) → distar.71: the revived clones are docile but poor at complex tasks; by empire type they join the workforce, become slaves, are assimilated, eaten, or leave on a colony ship when there is no room.
3. Study from afar (b) or "no room" leaves clones_in_cryo on the star. Colonising a repaired ring-world segment later fires distar.72 (on_colonized) to decide their fate.
4. Terminators and Fanatic Purifiers can exterminate them outright (influence and unity).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.70 五个选项按文明类型可用；a 进入项目，b/no_room 延后到殖民时的 distar.72，消灭选项直接结束。distar.72 可保留为纪念（矿藏）、解冻入籍、同化、照料（仆从）、作为食物（吞噬虫群）或抛入太空。

distar.70's five options depend on empire type; a leads to the project, b/no_room defer to distar.72 at colonisation, the extermination options end the story. distar.72 can keep them as a monument (deposit), thaw them into the workforce, assimilate, care for them (Servitors), feed them to the swarm, or eject them.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.70.a 不对普通机械智能（无终结者/同化者/仆从公民性）和非吞噬虫群的蜂巢开放。若玩家物种头像为 mam8，克隆体改用 rep15 头像。所有 distar.70 选项都会执行 pop_lcluster_event（有机会触发通用的“L星门见解”，不属于本故事）。

distar.70.a is closed to plain machine intelligences (no Terminator/Assimilator/Servitor civic) and non-swarm hive minds. If the player species uses portrait mam8 the clones use rep15. Every distar.70 option runs pop_lcluster_event (may fire the generic "L-Gate Insights", not part of this story).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对初始化、异常、distar.70–72、CRYO_CLONES_PROJECT 和 on_colonized。修正：distar.72 在草稿中是独立故事；现以两条按选项限定的审阅连接接在 distar.70.b / no_room 之后。

Checked initializer, anomaly, distar.70–72, CRYO_CLONES_PROJECT and on_colonized. Correction: distar.72 was a separate story; it now follows distar.70.b / no_room through two choice-specific reviewed links.
